name: const unsafe fn write_unaligned (self , val : T) where T : Sized ,
rule: When constructing the pointer wrapped by self to an unaligned packed struct field, no intermediate unaligned reference may be created, even temporarily before an immediate cast to a raw pointer; use &raw mut instead of forming such a reference.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < T > { const unsafe fn write_unaligned (self , val : T) where T : Sized , }
expression: The requirement is not expressible in the supplied DSL, which cannot observe intermediate reference creation during pointer construction.
